jobs.purpose: 指腹接触并顺着黑色织纹轻抚后移开；针织触感，不演示或承诺材料测试指标。
jobs.prompt: Warm ivory fashion editorial, natural movement at normal speed, one uncut shot. Preserve the SAME all-black high sock-knit slip-on shoes: rounded toe, broad raised transverse wavy knit across vamp and collar, finer side knit, triangular black heel reinforcement, short rear pull loop and thick matte-black grooved sole. No logos or text; typography will be added later. Start moving immediately from the reference pose: during 0–0.5s the index finger moves down the small gap to touch the upper knit vamp, during 0.5–2.2s the fingertip slowly strokes once for about three centimetres along the raised black knit ribs, and during 2.2–3s lifts away. The hand's visible contact and separation are the event, not a camera move. The shoe remains grounded and its sole rigid, with only subtle natural fabric contact. Keep five plausible fingers attached to one hand. Fixed elevated three-quarter camera, full shoe retained with margin throughout; detailed grazing light on BLACK fibres. Complete the touch-and-withdraw event once without dead lead-in, big stretch, shoe rotation, fabric transforming or freeze.

jobs.purpose: 从脚在鞋外到脚跟真正进鞋、扶口的手松开；一脚蹬的穿着过程。
jobs.prompt: Warm ivory fashion editorial, natural movement at normal speed, one uncut shot. Preserve the SAME all-black high sock-knit slip-on shoes: rounded toe, broad raised transverse wavy knit across vamp and collar, finer side knit, triangular black heel reinforcement, short rear pull loop and thick matte-black grooved sole. No logos or text; typography will be added later. Fixed elevated three-quarter side view, exactly the opening geometry in the reference. The bare foot is visibly outside the empty shoe. Starting immediately, the foot moves a few centimetres toward the oval TOP mouth, tips the toes down INTO that opening, then slides the forefoot toward the shoe front during 0–1.7s. The foot cannot enter through the front knit or sidewall; maintain a continuous visible path from air to the interior. During 1.7–3.7s the forefoot settles inside and the heel lowers THROUGH that same top opening into the original black heel cup while the thumb and index finger hold only the rear collar rim. The shoe stays on its original sole position, the collar gives a small normal fold rather than growing. During 3.7–4.7s the heel is fully seated, then the fingers let go and the hand withdraws. End during 4.7–5s with the ankle continuously attached to the foot INSIDE the shoe and the upper naturally settled. This is toe-first donning, NOT pulling a loop on an already worn shoe, not a crossfade between foot-out and foot-in. Keep the complete toe, heel, open mouth and guiding fingers in frame; preserve the short loop and heel reinforcement. The bare heel must move inside the cavity, never dissolve into the outside fabric, pass through the sidewall or remain perched outside.
failure_checks: 脚跟融入鞋外壁而非穿过鞋口
后拉环变长或鞋口长出
jobs.first_frame_review: The entire bare foot is outside the empty shoe with visible gap; toes need a small alignment toward the oval TOP mouth before descent. Guiding hand present for opening; no already-worn heel. Higher-risk contact action, not guaranteed.

jobs.purpose: 相同人物在暖白街道自然交替走路；双腿、双鞋持续完整。
jobs.prompt: Warm ivory fashion editorial, natural movement at normal speed, one uncut shot. Preserve the SAME all-black high sock-knit slip-on shoes: rounded toe, broad raised transverse wavy knit across vamp and collar, finer side knit, triangular black heel reinforcement, short rear pull loop and thick matte-black grooved sole. No logos or text; typography will be added later. Continue the woman's existing natural stride immediately for the entire six seconds, taking three to four relaxed alternating steps along the sunlit stone arcade. She keeps the same face, ivory cardigan, white top, cream wide trousers and tan handbag. Use a smooth full-body three-quarter tracking camera that retreats gently at her speed so head, both attached legs and BOTH complete shoes stay within the central 80 percent of the vertical frame with clear ground below the soles. The foot behind pushes off, swings forward and lands; the other foot then follows, with visible continuous weight transfer and natural trouser sway, handbag swing and background parallax. Maintain two connected legs and two separate identical black shoes at every instant, including occlusion; do not erase a leg. Moderate comfortable walking pace, no posing pauses, ankle-only crop, static support foot, sliding footwear or repeated boomerang cycle. End still walking IN FRAME, no exit or freeze. Do not alter architecture, shoe height, garment cut, face or skin.

jobs.purpose: 坐姿从翘腿到放下脚、两鞋落地，表达日常放松；不拿静态姿势撑四秒。
jobs.prompt: Warm ivory fashion editorial, natural movement at normal speed, one uncut shot. Preserve the SAME all-black high sock-knit slip-on shoes: rounded toe, broad raised transverse wavy knit across vamp and collar, finer side knit, triangular black heel reinforcement, short rear pull loop and thick matte-black grooved sole. No logos or text; typography will be added later. From the referenced seated crossed-leg pose, the woman gently uncrosses the raised leg and lowers its black shoe in one continuous natural arc to the ground beside, NOT on top of, the already grounded other shoe. Start the movement immediately, lower and plant during 0–2.8s, then settle both feet and knees naturally during 2.8–4s. Her hand rests naturally on the clothed knee for balance, never touches either shoe. Fixed framing as reference, both continuous trouser-shin-ankle-shoe connections remain readable, both full shoes retained with ground margin. Keep the original bench, sunlight, cream knit sleeve, cream trousers and BLACK knit shoes unchanged. A small natural shift in the trouser folds and foliage accompanies the movement; no new limbs, joint fusion, floating planted shoe, toe stretch, morphing camera zoom or four seconds of held photo. End with both soles grounded and feet relaxed.
